modules.module_title: Preparing for energy meter installation or replacement work

pcs.pc_description: obtain the information and details of the consumer for installation work
collect the necessary tools and equipment required for installation of smart energy meter
check the functionality of tools and equipment before use
check that the distance between the poles or cables is correct and underground and/or overhead cables are laid correctly
identify the reason such as stoppage of meter, erratic consumption output, broken seal, burning or damage of meter, service disconnection for changing the energy meter in case of replacement of meter

locate the area inside or outside the customer’s premise and check that the identified area is accessible to carry out installation, meter testing, commissioning, reading, recording and maintenance after assessing possible risks
inspect the facility’s wiring system and recognize any possible risks such as faulty circuit, loose ends, naked wires, etc.

check the consumer’s wiring system for any common phase or looping of phase of two or more consumers in case of new meter installation or identify the meter type, required tools and devices required during removal of meter in case of meter replacement

use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) for specific tasks and work conditions, contaminant (concentration w.r.t air) requirements and severity of hazard while conforming to the Indian/International standards

modules.module_title: Installing or replacing a single or three phase meter

pcs.pc_description: install or replace the energy meter and required supportive equipment such as meter box, junction box, distribution bus bar, etc. using appropriate insulated tools and devices as per organizational procedures
ensure the energy meter is correct, examined and tested, and meets all the parameters and specifications set by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)
equip the energy meter with various anti- tampering features as per regulations and organizational procedures

ensure that the energy meter is protected from various types of external factors such as magnetic induction, vibration, electrostatic discharge, switching transients, surge voltages, oblique suspension and harmonics in accordance with relevant regulations
check the energy meter for earth leakage indication as per Central Electricity Authority Regulations, 2006
test and calibrate the energy meter using appropriate testing devices in line with organizational quality standards and regulations
check that replaced meter is working properly and customer’s problems are duly resolved efficiently
ensure that energy meter display is working properly and showing the power usage details properly
escalate unresolved problems to appropriate authority for rectifications
record the meter data and maintain all the information related to the consumer’s energy meter
verify the accuracy of the meter data
maintain consumer meters’ account history, installation date and testing details, calibration and replacement of meters in line with organizational standards and policies
fill the installation or service report and take acknowledgment from the customer
document the work completed for future records
